section.sectionSummaryBrief: Notes on the discourse "Basi LeGani" from the year 5713.
From the holy hand of the Rebbe, may he live for many good years.
section.t: From the holy hand of the Rebbe, may he live for many good years.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In response to many questions on the discourse Basi LeGani, regarding the nations, shells, and sitra achra not transgressing His will.
section.t: In response to many questions on the discourse Basi LeGani,
the year 5713, end of section 2, and his language: The nations of the world, the shells, and the sitra achra do not transgress His will, blessed be He,
except that they call Him "Eloka d'Elohim" etc., but nevertheless they do not rebel against Him, blessed be He.
